# <Game> script map

This map records **<game>-specific** script roles, variable meanings, verb ids and room behaviour. Engine-defined variables and opcode rules are in the [SCUMM script reference](../engine/SCUMM_SCRIPT_MAP.md).

## Edition scope

Which edition(s) each table comes from (fixture folder, language, medium, date). Numbers from one edition are not transferred to another unless stated (R-14.2).

## Row format (every table below)

Each row: **item** | **meaning** | **evidence** (`decoded` / `engine` / `reading` / `play`, R-2.3) | **source** (`Script NN +0xOFFS`, `Room NN local script NN`, `Room NN object NN verb 0xHH`) | **date**. A row without a source is not allowed. Unnamed things keep their raw form.

## Boot and hooks

Boot script number, what it sets (ego, hook scripts, input script, cutscene hooks, text speed), the order in which it starts rooms and scripts.
